scope: Conditional local B7 refinements; same raw windows, RF frequencies, bank, geographic prior, original clock/timing/slope priors, seed and 25 km box for every condition. Gamma is an additional receiver-specific high-band prediction intercept with a zero mean 25 kHz prior. Enabled variants use identical data-only profiled gamma seeds; an enabled-zero-seed control tests optimization sensitivity. All c arms share the same upstream fitted-c conditioning and final bank; c=0 locks RF stretch and RF drift while keeping band gamma independent. The RF grouping and alias labels are assumed from the recorded evidence, not claimed as a physical hardware diagnosis.
